title: 链上巨鲸行为预警 · Overview

panels.title: 最近 24 小时巨鲸交易金额分布（USD / 小时）

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', datetime(timestamp,'unixepoch'), 'localtime')) AS INTEGER) ) AS time, SUM(value_usd) AS '金额(USD)' FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', datetime(timestamp,'unixepoch'), 'localtime')) AS INTEGER) ) AS time, SUM(value_usd) AS '金额(USD)' FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT direction AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY direction
targets.queryText: SELECT direction AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY direction

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS '时间', from_address AS '发送地址', to_address AS '接收地址', printf('%.4f', value_eth) AS 'ETH', printf('%.2f', value_usd) AS 'USD', direction AS '流向', value_usd AS 'value_usd' FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timestamp DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS '时间', from_address AS '发送地址', to_address AS '接收地址', printf('%.4f', value_eth) AS 'ETH', printf('%.2f', value_usd) AS 'USD', direction AS '流向', value_usd AS 'value_usd' FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY timestamp DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT direction AS '流向', ROUND(SUM(value_usd),0) AS '金额(USD)' FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-24 hours') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY direction ORDER BY '金额(USD)' DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT address AS '地址', direction AS '角色', printf('%.3f', eth_balance) AS 'ETH余额', printf('%.2f', stablecoin_usd) AS '稳定币USD', tx_count_24h AS '24h频次', tx_count_7d AS '7d频次', printf('%.2f', eth_usd_exposure) AS 'ETH敞口USD', is_contract AS '合约?', address_tag AS '标签', datetime(last_active_ts,'unixepoch','localtime') AS '最近活跃' FROM address_profiles ORDER BY eth_usd_exposure DESC

panels.title: 本周 vs 上周 · 巨鲸交易金额环比

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(value_usd) FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-7 days') AS INTEGER)) AS this_week, (SELECT SUM(value_usd) FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-14 days') AS INTEGER) AND CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%s','now','-7 days') AS INTEGER)) AS last_week
targets.queryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(value_usd) FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-7 days') AS INTEGER)) AS this_week, (SELECT SUM(value_usd) FROM whale_transfers WHERE CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-14 days') AS INTEGER) AND CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%s','now','-7 days') AS INTEGER)) AS last_week

panels.title: DoD 环比 · 每日巨鲸金额 + 日环比%（Last 7 days）

targets.rawQueryText: WITH daily AS (SELECT date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS d, SUM(value_usd) AS total FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY d) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', d) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(total,0) AS '日总额(USD)', ROUND((total - (SELECT total FROM daily p WHERE p.d < daily.d ORDER BY p.d DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT total FROM daily p WHERE p.d < daily.d ORDER BY p.d DESC LIMIT 1),0), 2) AS 'DoD环比%' FROM daily ORDER BY d
targets.queryText: WITH daily AS (SELECT date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS d, SUM(value_usd) AS total FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY d) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', d) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(total,0) AS '日总额(USD)', ROUND((total - (SELECT total FROM daily p WHERE p.d < daily.d ORDER BY p.d DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT total FROM daily p WHERE p.d < daily.d ORDER BY p.d DESC LIMIT 1),0), 2) AS 'DoD环比%' FROM daily ORDER BY d

panels.title: 7 日滚动平均 · 巨鲸日金额（Last 7 days）

targets.rawQueryText: WITH daily AS (SELECT date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS d, SUM(value_usd) AS total FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY d) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', d) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(total,0) AS '日总额(USD)', ROUND((SELECT AVG(total) FROM daily w WHERE w.d BETWEEN date(daily.d,'-6 days') AND daily.d),0) AS '7日滚动平均(USD)' FROM daily ORDER BY d
targets.queryText: WITH daily AS (SELECT date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime') AS d, SUM(value_usd) AS total FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY d) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', d) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(total,0) AS '日总额(USD)', ROUND((SELECT AVG(total) FROM daily w WHERE w.d BETWEEN date(daily.d,'-6 days') AND daily.d),0) AS '7日滚动平均(USD)' FROM daily ORDER BY d

panels.title: 堆叠面积 · 每日流向金额构成（Last 7 days）

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime')) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_inflow' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '交易所流入', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_outflow' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '交易所流出', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='peer_to_peer' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '点对点' FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(timestamp,'unixepoch','localtime')) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_inflow' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '交易所流入', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_outflow' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '交易所流出', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='peer_to_peer' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS '点对点' FROM whale_transfers GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 热力图 · 巨鲸交易金额密度（Last 7 days）

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(value_usd,0) AS '金额' FROM whale_transfers ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(value_usd,0) AS '金额' FROM whale_transfers ORDER BY time

panels.title: 累计净额 · 交易所累计净流入（Last 7 days）

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t AS time, ROUND((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_inflow' THEN value_usd WHEN direction='exchange_outflow' THEN -value_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM whale_transfers w2 WHERE CAST(w2.timestamp AS INTEGER) <= t),0) AS '累计净流入交易所(USD)' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) AS t FROM whale_transfers) ORDER BY t
targets.queryText: SELECT t AS time, ROUND((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN direction='exchange_inflow' THEN value_usd WHEN direction='exchange_outflow' THEN -value_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM whale_transfers w2 WHERE CAST(w2.timestamp AS INTEGER) <= t),0) AS '累计净流入交易所(USD)' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(timestamp AS INTEGER) AS t FROM whale_transfers) ORDER BY t

options.content:
**本分支将看板时间范围默认设为 Last 7 days，并预留 7D / 30D 数据展示位：**

- **7D（预留）**：7 日累计巨鲸金额、7 日均值、7 日净流入趋势
- **30D（预留）**：30 日活跃度、30 日累计净额、月内 Top 地址

> 数据随 `scan_state` 持续累积而变厚，届时可直接将预留位替换为正式面板。
